title: Idhu Namma Aalu
desc: A lower-caste man marries a girl of a higher caste by hiding his true social background.

title: Annan
desc: Velan feels happy when his sister, Lakshmi, marries Selvam, a police officer. However, Velan is shocked when Selvam accuses him of killing his father.

title: Aanazhagan
desc: Raja disguises himself as a married woman to find a rental house for his friends. However, trouble brews when he falls for the landlady's daughter.

title: Jithan 2
desc: A man with a reserved nature finds his life in danger when he discovers that his newly purchased home is haunted by a ghost.

title: Pandi Nattu Thangam
desc: A village chief and his father, who control the village activities besides smuggling sandalwood, create problems for a forest officer, Thangapandian, and a fellow villager, Radha.
